# Wayfinder

> Indoor mapping, turn-by-turn navigation, directory kiosks and parking guidance for large venues: malls, hospitals, airports, campuses, museums and exhibition centres. Delivered as map production plus positioning design, the platform behind it, kiosks, integration, calibration, acceptance testing and support.

This site is deliberately small. Every page answers a question a technical buyer can check: run the routing engine, read the acceptance protocol, read the data summary, or read the terms that go in the contract. Pages that would need client evidence we do not yet have permission to publish were removed rather than padded.

## Pages

- /: what the system does, the live demo, venue types, positioning options and delivery models
- /indoor-navigation-system/: turn-by-turn routing across floors, landmark-based steps, step-free option, integration and admin
- /indoor-positioning-system/: BLE, UWB, Wi-Fi and hybrid positioning, accuracy ranges, floor detection, calibration
- /indoor-mapping/: floor plates, points of interest, walk graph, map editor, data ownership
- /parking-guidance-system/: bay guidance, reverse car finding by plate or bay number, reservation, parking-system integration
- /venues/: how the content model changes by venue type, plus the kiosk layer and optional operations modules
- /indoor-wayfinding-price/: what drives cost, three delivery scopes, how a budget is built, no invented amounts
- /demo/: a working three-level map with search, turn list and step-free recalculation
- /delivery/: the six clauses we put in a contract, support severity levels, data ownership and exit
- /downloads/: technical specification template, acceptance test protocol, data processing summary (PDF)
- /about/: what we do ourselves, how we scope and accept a project, what we will not claim
- /contact/: how to reach us

## Documents

- /downloads/indoor-wayfinding-technical-specification.pdf: tender-ready specification with MUST/SHOULD requirements, per-zone accuracy targets, interface list, performance and acceptance
- /downloads/acceptance-test-protocol.pdf: sampling method, ten fixed routes, defect classes and sign-off
- /downloads/data-processing-summary.pdf: data categories, what is not collected, retention, security, exit

## Scope and boundaries

- Not offered: consumer navigation apps, outdoor mapping, robot or drone navigation, asset tracking, RTLS hardware, camera-based identity tracking.
- Beacons and UWB are specified and integrated, not manufactured.
- Staff location is limited to dispatch, patrol and emergency mustering on consenting devices.
- No client name, logo or performance figure is published without written permission.
